name: Stormwind Gate
summary: At Stormwind Gate, sentries watch the road between Elwynn Forest and Stormwind City. The passage opens onto the Valley of Heroes, where the city’s stone monuments rise beyond the arch.

sections.title: The Threshold of the Kingdom
sections.body: Stormwind Gate guards the southern road from Elwynn Forest into the capital. The Stormwind City Guard watches from the stone portal, while patrols move between the outer arch and the Valley of Heroes. Unrest lingers in Elwynn, yet the massive iron and stone gates stay open. Travelers, merchants, and returning defenders pass through into the heart of the Alliance.

faq.q: Where does the Stormwind Gate lead?
faq.answer: From Elwynn Forest, the gate opens directly onto the Valley of Heroes, Stormwind City’s grand entryway, lined with towering monuments to the Second War.

faq.q: Why is the gate left open if Elwynn Forest is dangerous?
faq.answer: Stormwind keeps the passage open for trade and travel from Goldshire and across the Alliance. Guards watch for bandits and Defias activity in the woods while citizens and commerce continue through the gate.
The Stormwind City Guard garrisons the entryway. Two sentries watch just outside in Elwynn Forest, two more guard the inner passage, and armed footmen patrol the bridge through the Valley of Heroes.

faq.q: Are there special events held at the gate?
faq.answer: Yes. The open ground around Stormwind Gate often hosts major citywide holidays and seasonal gatherings for the Alliance. It gives the city a place to assemble beyond its crowded districts.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the gate is a sign of safety and endurance. Traveling soldiers and young adventurers first glimpse the Grand Alliance’s majesty here.
For the people of Stormwind, passing back through these stone arches means coming home to safety after long journeys through Elwynn and beyond.
